final_topology.title: Financial Data Ingestion Network
final_topology.description: A network designed for ingesting financial data feeds and processing them in dedicated market data pods, with outputs distributed to three campus sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network includes dedicated pods for data ingestion and processing, connected to three campus sites via trunk links for inter-site communication. Segmentation is enforced by function.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory Zone' with an 'Asset Inventory System' and multiple 'Asset Inventory Zone Management Service' nodes, indicating a structured approach to maintaining an asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes detailed data flow links between various nodes, such as 'Ingestion to Feed Handler 1', 'Feed Handler 1 to Analytics Workload 1', etc., which strongly implies documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different functions, such as 'Ingestion Pod', 'Market Data Pod 1', 'Market Data Pod 2', 'Non-Production Zone', and 'Security Zone', indicating segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls ('Firewall 1' and 'Firewall 2') in the 'Security Zone', and there are peering links between the security zone and other zones, indicating the presence and management of firewalls.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'DNS Server 1' and 'DNS Server 2' in the 'Security Zone', and there are data flow links from these DNS servers to various nodes, indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' in the 'Security Zone' and data flow links from the MFA server to the 'Bastion Host' and 'Admin Workstations', indicating that MFA is required for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' in the 'Security Zone' with data flow links to various nodes, indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' in the 'Security Zone' with data flow links to various nodes, indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones with defined functions and peering links, indicating a well-designed and maintained secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' and '802.1X Controller' in the 'Security Zone', indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' in the 'Security Zone' with management links to various nodes, indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' in the 'Remote Access Zone' with data flow links to the 'Bastion Host' and 'Admin Workstations', indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Zone' with 'Admin Workstations' and a 'Bastion Host', indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' in the 'Security Zone' with monitoring links to firewalls, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls ('Firewall 1' and 'Firewall 2') in the 'Security Zone' with peering links to other zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' and 'Central AAA Server' in the 'Security Zone' with management links to the 'Bastion Host' and 'Admin Workstations', indicating managed access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' in the 'Security Zone' with monitoring links from firewalls, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' in the 'Security Zone' with monitoring links to firewalls, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' in the 'Security Zone' with management links to firewalls, indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' in the 'Security Zone' with data flow links to various nodes, indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' with a 'Non-Production Zone Application Server', indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'External Testing Zone' with a 'Pen Test Workstation' and a 'Pen Test Scheduler', indicating the capability to perform periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various zones and nodes, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing an asset inventory system and links indicating data flows for inventory updates.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a bastion host (n24) and links indicating its use by admin workstations, but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links indicating its use by remote devices.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n15) and a central AAA server (n18), but there is no explicit evidence of access control based on software and configuration compliance.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control based on software and configuration compliance.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes and links indicating access control policies and compliance checks.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an external testing zone (z10) and a pen test workstation (n27), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes and links indicating the scheduling and execution of periodic penetration tests.
